trickyParts: push-built never checks out main's tip: a temporary index (read-tree tip, add -A the two directories from the work tree at base, write-tree, commit-tree) builds the commit, because the tip may carry another release-push.sh and a checkout would rewrite the running script.
deploy_key_env is idempotent and every temp directory shares one EXIT trap (on_exit_remove), since push-built and land_on_main both set up the key.
land_on_main records landed=pushed|restarted so push-built never starts a second fresh run after land_on_main already started one (main moved again between fetch and push).

git diff limits paths before pairing renames, so a rename out of the inputs lists its old path with or without --no-renames; --no-renames matters for a rename inside the inputs (test case rename-inside).
main_build_base reads only a github-actions[bot] commit with the exact rebuild subject whose named commit is its ancestor; anything else touching dist/legion counts as a build of at most itself.
